```yaml
name: Analyze

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner_os:
        description: 'Runner OS'
        required: true
        default: 'ubuntu-latest'
        type: string
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET Core SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: csharp
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          config-file: tools/ci/codeql-config.yml

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          matrix: |
            { "language": "csharp", "os": "${{ inputs.runner_os }}" }
          working-directory: .

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          upload: true
          cleanup-level: full
          ram: 4GB
          checkout_path: .
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          category: security
          upload-database: true
          post-processed-sarif-path: results.sarif
          wait-for-processing: false
```

name: Linux CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Invoke CI Build
        powershell: |
          & tools\ci.psm1 -Configuration Release -RunAnalyzeJob

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./TestResults

name: Windows CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-analyze:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: analyze
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Invoke CI Build
        powershell: |
          & tools\ci.psm1 -Configuration Release -RunAnalyzeJob

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./TestResults

function Invoke-CIBuild {
    param (
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
        [ValidateSet('Debug', 'Release', 'CodeCoverage', 'StaticAnalysis')]
        [string]$Configuration = 'Release',

        [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
        [switch]$RunAnalyzeJob
    )

    # Your existing build logic here...

    if ($RunAnalyzeJob) {
        $analyzeWorkflowPath = ".github/workflows/analyze-reusable.yml"
        $analyzeWorkflowYaml = Get-Content -Path $analyzeWorkflowPath -Raw
        $analyzeWorkflowYaml = $analyzeWorkflowYaml -replace '"runner_os": "ubuntu-latest"', '"runner_os": "windows-latest"'
        Set-Content -Path $analyzeWorkflowPath -Value $analyzeWorkflowYaml

        Register-GitHubWorkflow -Name "analyze" -Path $analyzeWorkflowPath -Inputs @{ runner_os = "windows-latest" }

        Start-GitHubWorkflowRun -Name "analyze"

        Remove-Item -Path $analyzeWorkflowPath
    }
}
